fire: The county set the levy at $3.20 per $1,000 of assessed value for the coming year.

The exemption lets seniors remove part of their home's value from their tax bill.

Residents pay for the new sewer through their tax and water bills over twenty years.
The board met to estimate the county's fiscal needs and set the tax rate.
quiet: The shop set the price at $3.20 per pound of roasted coffee for the coming year.
Voters will notice the school mural on their way to the polls in November.
The new mall is expected to enlarge the town's parking area by several hundred spaces.
